### God's Glory as Creator
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-glory-as-creator
Passage: Revelation 4:11
Points:
- Giving glory to God means treating Him with the infinite weight and honor He deserves.
- Human praise cannot add to God's inherent perfection, but properly acknowledges who He is.
- Revelation 4:11 reveals that God is worthy of adoration because He called all things into existence out of nothing.
- As dependent creatures sustained solely by divine will, people owe their highest honor to the Creator alone.
- Believers must avoid taking the world for granted and daily thank God for their existence.

### Casting Down Our Golden Crowns
Author: Laura MacCorkle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/casting-down-our-golden-crowns-crosswalk-the-devotional-oct-18-2010-11639017.html
Passage: Revelation 4:11
Points:
- The heavenly elders model ultimate worship by casting their crowns before God's throne.
- These crowns represent victories and divine rewards that are returned to their true Giver.
- God alone deserves total praise and honor because He created and sustains all things.
- Believers are invited to reflect on whether they view their life's blessings as God's property.
- Christian living requires loosening one's grip on earthly gifts to surrender them back to God.
